standouts.text: MACD is above its signal line and above zero, with the histogram rising.
standouts.learn: The gap between a fast and a slow average of price; a cross up through its signal says momentum is turning.

against.head: Momentum stuck in a bear range
against.text: RSI has failed below 60 on every bounce for three months and fell to 28: the range momentum holds in a downtrend.
against.learn: In uptrends RSI tends to hold 40 on dips and reach 70; in downtrends it fails near 60 and reaches 30.

against.head: Weekly: a pullback that is not done
against.text: The pullback from the Jul 13 high is not done: it has not reached the 0.5 retracement and selling volume is rising. A wave 2 usually unfolds in three waves and reaches the 0.618–0.786 of the Apr 21, 2025–Jul 13 advance (−15% to −22%).
against.learn: A real wave 2 takes three waves and time, on lighter volume. Too shallow, too quick, one straight leg or rising selling says it has further to go.

material.head: Sitting on stacked support
material.text: Price sits on the October breakout level, the 200-day average and the 38.2% retracement of the Oct 1–Nov 2 rise, where 8 levels (4 kinds) meet.
material.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.

material.head: Retesting its breakout level
material.text: It broke out above the February high and has come back to test it from above: old resistance acting as new support.
material.learn: After a breakout, price often comes back to the line it broke; old resistance becomes new support.

material.head: Next support −1.6% below
material.text: The next floor under it is −1.6% below (1 ATR), where 7 levels (3 kinds) meet: the average price paid since the Oct 1 low, the 50-week average and the 61.8% retracement of the Oct 1–Nov 2 rise.
material.learn: A price where buyers stepped in before.

material.head: Reclaimed its 50-day average
material.text: It closed back above its 50-day average in the last three sessions.
material.learn: The average close of the last 20, 50 or 200 sessions; rising averages mark uptrends and often act as support.

material.head: Back above its averages
material.text: Price has climbed back above both its 50-day and 200-day averages.
